description: This is an HTML source file that defines the structure, style, and client-side logic for a Web-based Database Viewer interface. It includes markup for database and table selection, data display, and user interaction via JavaScript.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Handles the refresh action for reloading the list of databases.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with the fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cells, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or object data types.
